shots.name: m-array
shots.prompt:
An isometric arrangement of exactly five tablets laid out on a flat surface, seen from a high angle so all of them recede in parallel across the frame.

COUNT: exactly five devices. Not six, not nine. Five.

Each of the five shows a DIFFERENT one of the five supplied interfaces, one interface per device, reproduced as given and filling its display. Screen one: the home screen with its red dotted sphere and greeting. Screen two: the file browser with its left sidebar and file rows. Screen three: the dense history table with its filter tabs. Screen four: the dialog with its orange primary button. Screen five: the overlay with its sphere and dark input field.

NO REPEATS: every screen in the frame must be different from every other screen in the frame. The same interface must never appear twice. No device is blank, dark or switched off.

Arrangement: the five sit in two staggered rows with generous space between them, all at the same angle, all fully inside the frame. One near the centre is lifted slightly and is rendered crisp and fully legible.

Device accuracy: correctly proportioned tablets. Do not stretch, widen, squash or distort any device or screen.

Set: a flat dark surface with a faint fine grid printed on it. Nothing else in frame.

Light: soft even light from above, gentle long shadows falling consistently to one side, a faint red ambient bleed from the screens onto the surface.

Strictly avoid: repeated or duplicated screens, more than five devices, blank or dark screens, flat colour fills, devices at inconsistent angles, stretched devices, bloom, haze, lens flare, sci-fi styling, hands, people.

Finish: clean isometric product render, deep focus, everything sharp. Systematic, graphic, dark.

shots.name: m-flatlay
shots.prompt:
Exactly three flat screen panels laid out at a shallow angle on a dark surface, seen from a high three quarter view so they sit in a stepped row receding to the upper right.

COUNT: exactly three panels. Not five, not six. Three.

Each shows a DIFFERENT one of the three supplied interfaces, one per panel, reproduced as given and filling its face. Panel one: the dense history table with its filter tabs. Panel two: the dialog with its orange primary button. Panel three: the file browser with its left sidebar.

NO REPEATS: every screen must be different from every other screen in the frame. The same interface must never appear twice. No panel is blank or dark.

Arrangement: all three at the same angle, evenly spaced, all fully inside the frame with none cut off at the edges. All three rendered crisp and legible.

Accuracy: identically shaped, correctly proportioned panels. Do not stretch, squash or distort any panel or screen.

Set: a dark matte surface, edge to edge, nothing else in frame.

Light: one broad soft light from the left, consistent soft shadows under every panel, a faint red spill on the surface.

Strictly avoid: repeated or duplicated screens, more than three panels, blank panels, flat colour fills, panels cropped by the frame edge, stretched panels, bloom, haze, lens flare, sci-fi styling, hands, people.

Finish: overhead editorial product photography, deep focus. Graphic, systematic, dark.
